blocks.text: Belcarra Houses: rules that affect buyers

items.t: Belcarra runs its own bylaws: the 2024 Official Community Plan (Bylaw No. 621, 2024) and Zoning Bylaw No. 510, 2018 govern permits and lots, not Port Moody's bylaws, even though the postal and real-estate area name is Port Moody.

Servicing is the binding constraint: houses here rely on on-site septic, and the Village ties any wider permissions to septic and water capacity, while the municipal water system serves the majority of properties in Belcarra Bay and Bedwell Bay.

blocks.text: Belcarra Houses: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: təmtəmíxʷtən/Belcarra Regional Park, run by Metro Vancouver, holds White Pine Beach on Sasamat Lake and the Belcarra picnic area on the inlet, with a 3.2-kilometre Sasamat Lake Loop Trail, and park traffic uses the same Bedwell Bay Road residents use.
Fire protection is volunteer: the Sasamat Volunteer Fire Department is the village's fire service named in the Official Community Plan.
The Village Hall stands at 4084 Bedwell Bay Road on the single spine road, so every civic service is on the one road in and out.
Belcarra sets its own property taxes as a separate municipality, and the Village budgets its Waste and Recycling Depot as its own operating fund with its own rate increases, separate from water.
The speculation and vacancy tax applies in Belcarra, so owners declare annually.
Bedwell Bay Road is the only road in and out: it enters from Port Moody and runs past the Village Hall at 4084 Bedwell Bay Road to both the Belcarra Bay and Bedwell Bay street systems.
A TransLink community shuttle serves the village, per the Official Community Plan's facilities map — there is no conventional bus route or rail station in Belcarra.

blocks.text: Belcarra Houses: risks and due diligence

items.t: Test the septic system and confirm its capacity before adding any accessory unit, because the Village ties added units to septic and water capacity and there is no municipal sewer.

Confirm whether the specific property is connected to the municipal water system, since the Official Community Plan says the system serves the majority of properties in Belcarra Bay and Bedwell Bay, without a lot list.
Confirm the SD43 catchment schools for the exact address, since no school building stands in the village.
